title: The tourist cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the town's parking: every space on main street full, out-of-state plates drawn as blocks, the dog in the one empty space. The owner says that's not a space. Wood says it is now. She says the dog can't hold a space. He says watch him.

panels.composition: The cover: main street full of parked cars, plates as blocks, and in the one gap a small dog sitting square in the middle of it.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing a main street full of parked cars with a small dog sitting squarely in the one empty space, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner holding a small booklet and speaking to a young man with a small dog, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The owner looking at the dog. The dog looking back. Holding the doorway like a space.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner and a small dog regarding each other, the dog sitting squarely in the doorway, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The rack. The cover. The dog on it in the gap. The town's August, held by a dog.
